Package edu.scu.phantommaze.model

Class Enemy

java.lang.Object
edu.scu.phantommaze.model.Enemy
public class Enemy extends Object
One Doom enemy (a Pac-Man "ghost"). It walks from tile center to tile center along the grid; EnemyAI decides which way to turn each time it reaches a center.
